title: Austin Budget: Police, Housing, Parks, Arts
meeting_type: Austin City Council Budget Work Session
summary:
*   City Council reviewed the proposed budget for the upcoming fiscal year and will proceed with setting the maximum property tax rate.
*   A major debate unfolded over an proposed $18.2 million police funding increase, with numerous public speakers advocating for reallocation to community services, housing, and mental health programs.
*   Addressing Austin's homelessness crisis was a top concern, with calls for more investment in rapid rehousing and permanent supportive housing; a dedicated work session on the homelessness response system is scheduled.
*   Community members also urged increased funding for parks maintenance and facility upgrades, alongside support for the arts by reallocating Hotel Occupancy Tax funds.
